item.title: Republicans and Democrats find a unifying target: Pharmacy benefit managers
item.description: Republicans and Democrats, both patients and politicians, seem united in their disdain for the healthcare companies known as pharmacy benefit managers. Tennessee and Arkansas are regulating them now.

item.title: From floating saunas to clinical trials: How heat might help mental health
item.description: While scientists have a decent understanding of how sauna and other forms of heat exposure exercises our cardiovascular system, they know relatively little about its impact on mental health.

item.title: After failed execution, health workers say Tennessee's method flouts medical ethics
